about: Ayaan has been part of Wizkidz since the very beginning and now I can proudly say that he is in the 10th level. It has been an enriching experience to both Ayaan and to us, his parents to see him achieve not only proficiency in maths but also to see him develop in his general problem solving skills. The national level competition held annually has always boosted his confidence levels.

With reference to my son who is currently in the above level 7 with you, I wish to express my gratitude and thanks to the entire teaching staff who have very devotedly been an integral part of Angad's success.
